provenance.value: In the main loop of scalar_search_wolfe2, the check `alpha1 == 0 or (amax is not None and alpha0 == amax)` fires when alpha0 equals amax (e.g. when the initial step alpha1 was clipped to amax by `alpha1 = min(alpha1, amax)`), so on i == 1 the line search exits early with a LineSearchWarning saying it could not find a solution less than or equal to amax, causing line_search to report non-convergence.

The loop should not terminate just because alpha0 equals amax; amax is a valid step length. The check was changed to `alpha0 > amax`, so the early-exit warning only fires when alpha0 actually exceeds amax.
